sqlalchemy: SQLAlchemy: the package a query type is imported from, and this pack's name
Query: SQLAlchemy: what a query against mapped classes comes back as
Session: SQLAlchemy: the unit of work a query runs inside
update: SQLAlchemy: the Query method that writes matched rows
delete: SQLAlchemy: the Query method that removes matched rows
add: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that stages a new object
add_all: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that stages several
merge: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that writes detached state back
commit: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that makes staged work permanent
insert: SQLAlchemy: the 2.0 construct that adds rows
select: SQLAlchemy: the 2.0 function that builds a SELECT, imported at the call site
flush: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that sends staged work to the database without committing
bulk_save_objects: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that writes a list of objects in bulk
bulk_insert_mappings: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that inserts rows from a list of dicts
bulk_update_mappings: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that updates rows from a list of dicts
execute: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that runs a statement built elsewhere
scalars: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that runs a statement and returns its first column
scalar: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that runs a statement and returns one value
begin: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that opens a transaction
rollback: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that discards staged work
close: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that ends the session
expire: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that marks an object's attributes stale
expire_all: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that marks every loaded object stale
expunge: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that detaches an object
expunge_all: SQLAlchemy: the Session method that detaches every object
values: SQLAlchemy: the 2.0 statement method that supplies column values
